text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Parliament is expected to discuss the draft of the 1997 budget within the next 30 days, said National Peasant Party leader Ion Diaconescu.
- RomTelecom telephone authority will call tender to designate consultant for its privatisation programme.
- Aircraft maker Boeing could manufacture some aircraft parts in Romania, Boeing manager Dick Albrecht said after a meeting with Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea.
- Romanian state airline Tarom SA will buy Boeing aircrafts for its fleet.
- State-owned bank Banca Romana de Comert Exterior Bancorex SA is "stable and strong", central bank (BNR) governor Mugur Isarescu said after the recent management shake-up at Bancorex.
- New Bancorex president Florin Ionescu appointed four vice-presidents on the bank's board.

- Custom taxes dropped by 10 percent due to a stronger leu national currency. The customs authorities use the BNR rate to compute tax deductions. The BNR rate for the whole week is 6,942 lei to the dollar.
- State-run car maker Automobile Dacia Pitesti SA will export Dacia cars to China.
- Shortage of funds affect start of seasonal farm works.
